1029-the-night-born.title: The Night Born
1029-the-night-born.creator: Jack London
1029-the-night-born.description: A book by Jack London. I was young twelve years ago, and I had hair on top of my head, and my stomach was lean as a runner's, and the longest day was none too long for me. I was a husky back there in '98. Wasn't I a pretty good bit of all right?”

35422-the-two-goats-and-the-sick-monkey.title: The Two Goats And The Sick Monkey
35422-the-two-goats-and-the-sick-monkey.creator: Unknown
35422-the-two-goats-and-the-sick-monkey.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. an run up a tree just as easy as we can upon the ground, and play and sport on the very ends of the branches. He takes his victuals in his two fore paws, and eats like a squirrel. The hunters shoot him for his fur, which they sell to the hatters.

arxiv-2209-10054.title: Multi band Fermi surface in 1T-VSe 2 and its implication for charge density wave phase
arxiv-2209-10054.creator: Turgut Yilmaz, Boris Sinkovic, Elio Vescovo
arxiv-2209-10054.description: Abstract Here, our angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy experiment reveled that the surface band structure of the 1T-VSe 2 host electronic states that was not predicted or probed before. Earlier claims to support charge density wave phase can be all explained in terms of these new findings.

arxiv-2209-11246.title: Neutron Depolarization due to Ferromagnetism and Spin Freezing in CePd 1-x Rh x
arxiv-2209-11246.creator: M. Seifert, P. Schmakat, M. Schulz, P. Jorba, V. Hutanu, C. Geibel, M. Deppe, C. Pfleiderer
arxiv-2209-11246.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Seifert, P. Schmakat, M. Schulz, P. Jorba, V. Hutanu, C. Geibel, M. Deppe, C. Pfleiderer. We report neutron depolarization measurements of the suppression of long-range ferromagnetism and the emergence of magnetic irreversibilities and spin freezing in CePd 1-x Rh x around x ∗ ≈ 0.6 x^{*}\approx 0.6 .

arxiv-2304-13239.title: Numerical Approximation of Andrews Plots with Optimal Spatial-Spectral Smoothing
arxiv-2304-13239.creator: Mitchell Rimerman, Nate Strawn
arxiv-2304-13239.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mitchell Rimerman, Nate Strawn. Andrews plots provide aesthetically pleasant visualizations of high-dimensional datasets. This work proves that Andrews plots (when defined in terms of the principal component scores of a dataset) are optimally “smooth” on average, and solve an infinite-dimensional quadratic minimization program over the set of linear isometries from the Euclidean data space to L 2 ​ ( [ 0 , 1 ] ) L^{2}([0,1]) .

arxiv-2306-07665.title: Liquid-Crystal-Based Controllable Attenuators Operating in the 1–4 Terahertz Band
arxiv-2306-07665.creator: Aniela Dunn, Zhaopeng Zhang, Michael D. Horbury, Eleanor V. Nuttall, Yingjun Han, Mohammed Salih, Lianhe Li, Abigail Bond, Ehab Saleh, Russell Harris, Diego Pardo, Brian N. Ellison, Andrew D. Burnett, Helen F. Gleeson, Alexander Valavanis
arxiv-2306-07665.description: Abstract Liquid-crystal devices (LCDs) offer a potential route toward adaptive optical components for use in the < 2 THz band of the electromagnetic spectrum. We demonstrate LCDs using a commercially available material (E7), with unbiased birefringence values of 0.14–0.18 in the 0.3–4 THz band. We exploit the linear dichroism of the material to modulate the emission from a 3.

arxiv-2309-15207.title: Balancing Computational Efficiency and Forecast Error in Machine Learning-based Time-Series Forecasting: Insights from Live Experiments on Meteorological Nowcasting
arxiv-2309-15207.creator: Elin Törnquist, Wagner Costa Santos, Timothy Pogue, Nicholas Wingle, Robert A. Caulk
arxiv-2309-15207.description: Abstract Machine learning for time-series forecasting remains a key area of research. Despite successful application of many machine learning techniques, relating computational efficiency to forecast error remains an under-explored domain. This paper addresses this topic through a series of real-time experiments to quantify the relationship between computational cost and forecast error using meteorological nowcasting as an example use-case.

arxiv-2401-12313.title: Eliashberg theory for dynamical screening in bilayer exciton condensation
arxiv-2401-12313.creator: G. J. Sreejith 1,2 , Jay D. Sau 2 and Sankar Das Sarma 2
arxiv-2401-12313.description: Abstract We study the effect of dynamical screening of interactions on the transition temperatures ( T c T_{c} ) of exciton condensation in a symmetric bilayer of quadratically dispersing electrons and holes by solving the linearized Eliashberg equations for the anomalous interlayer Green’s functions.

arxiv-2404-01482.title: Atmospheric limitations for high-frequency ground-based VLBI
arxiv-2404-01482.creator: Dominic W. Pesce, Lindy Blackburn, Ryan Chaves, Sheperd S. Doeleman, Mark Freeman, Sara Issaoun, Michael D. Johnson, Greg Lindahl, Iniyan Natarajan, Scott N. Paine, Daniel C. M. Palumbo, Freek Roelofs, Paul Tiede
arxiv-2404-01482.description: Abstract Very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) provides the highest-resolution images in astronomy. The sharpest resolution is nominally achieved at the highest frequencies, but as the observing frequency increases so too does the atmospheric contribution to the system noise, degrading the sensitivity of the array and hampering detection.

arxiv-2405-16098.title: Lateralization MLP: A Simple Brain-inspired Architecture for Diffusion
arxiv-2405-16098.creator: Zizhao Hu, Mohammad Rostami
arxiv-2405-16098.description: Abstract The Transformer architecture has dominated machine learning in a wide range of tasks. The specific characteristic of this architecture is an expensive scaled dot-product attention mechanism that models the inter-token interactions, which is known to be the reason behind its success.

arxiv-2503-13793.title: Mapping the Trust Terrain: LLMs in Software Engineering - Insights and Perspectives
arxiv-2503-13793.creator: Dipin Khati, Yijin Liu, David N. Palacio, Yixuan Zhang, Denys Poshyvanyk
arxiv-2503-13793.description: Abstract . The application of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Software Engineering (SE) continues to grow rapidly across both industry and academia. As these models become integral to critical SE processes, ensuring their reliability and trustworthiness becomes essential. Achieving this requires a balanced approach to trust: excessive trust can introduce security vulnerabilities, while insufficient trust may hinder innovation.

arxiv-2507-11463.title: The Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund Property for Riemann Differences with Geometric Nodes
arxiv-2507-11463.creator: Hajrudin Fejzić
arxiv-2507-11463.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hajrudin Fejzić. We study when a Riemann difference of order n n possesses the Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund (MZ) property: that is, whether the conditions f ⁡ ( h ) = o ⁡ ( h n − 1 ) f(h)=o(h^{n-1}) and D ​ f ​ ( h ) = o ⁡ ( h n ) Df(h)=o(h^{n}) imply f ⁡ ( h ) = o ⁡ ( h n ) f(h)=o(h^{n}) .

britannica-1911-anubis.title: Anubis (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-anubis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-anubis.description: Article 'Anubis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Anubis was the principal god in the capitals of the XVIIth and XVIIIth nomes of Upper Egypt, and secondary god in the XIIIth and probably in the XIIth nome; but his cult was universal. To begin with, he was the god of the dead, of the cemetery, of all supplies for the dead, and therefore of embalming when that became customary.

From the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 2 edition (1892). A principal work of the early church, among the foundational texts of Christian antiquity.

pmc-10627156.title: Uncovering the complex regulatory network of spring bud sprouting in tea plants: insights from metabolic, hormonal, and oxidative stress pathways
pmc-10627156.creator: Junwei Tang, Yao Chen, Chao Huang, Congcong Li, Yue Feng, Haoqian Wang, Changqing Ding, Nana Li, Lu Wang, Jianming Zeng, Yajun Yang, Xinyuan Hao, Xinchao Wang
pmc-10627156.description: The sprouting process of tea buds is an essential determinant of tea quality and taste, thus profoundly impacting the tea industry. Buds spring sprouting is also a crucial biological process adapting to external environment for tea plants and regulated by complex transcriptional and metabolic networks.

pmc-10675779.title: Fast Stray Light Performance Evaluation Based on BSDF and Radiative Transfer Theory
pmc-10675779.creator: Chaoli Zeng, Guangqing Xia, Xing Zhong, Lei Li, Zheng Qu, Qinhai Yang, Yuanhang Wang, Piotr Lesiak
pmc-10675779.description: Evaluating the stray light cancellation performance of an optical system is an essential step in the search for superior optical systems. However, the existing evaluation methods, such as the Monte Carlo method and the ray tracing method, suffer from the problems of vast arithmetic and cumbersome processes.

pmc-11579429.title: Bridging the gap: unravelling plant centromeres in the telomere‐to‐telomere era
pmc-11579429.creator: Matthew Naish
pmc-11579429.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryCentromeres are specific regions of the chromosomes that play a pivotal role in the segregation of chromosomes, by facilitating the loading of the kinetochore, which forms the link between the chromosomes to the spindle fibres during cell division. In plants and animals, these regions often form megabase‐scale loci of tandemly repeated DNA sequences, which have presented a challenge to genomic studies even in model species.

pmc-11599690.title: Association Between Inter-Limb Asymmetry and Determinants of Middle- and Long-distance Running Performance in Healthy Populations: A Systematic Review
pmc-11599690.creator: Joachim D’Hondt, Laurent Chapelle, Chris Bishop, Dirk Aerenhouts, Kevin De Pauw, Peter Clarys, Eva D’Hondt
pmc-11599690.description: BackgroundThe presence of inter-limb asymmetry in the human body has traditionally been perceived to be detrimental for athletic performance. However, a systematic review addressing and comprehensively assessing the association of asymmetry between the lower limbs and middle- and long-distance running performance-related metrics is currently lacking.

pmc-12525139.title: Transpancreatic Sphincterotomy Is a Safe and Effective Pancreatic Guidewire-Assisted Cannulation Method: Real-World Data Analysis of the Hungarian ERCP Registry
pmc-12525139.creator: Dániel Pécsi, Nelli Farkas, Szilárd Gódi, Péter Hegyi, Andrea Szentesi, István Altorjay, Tamás Bakucz, Ákos Orbán-Szilágyi, Zoltán Szepes, László Czakó, Árpád Patai, Tibor Gyökeres, Roland Fejes, Zsolt Dubravcsik, Áron Vincze
pmc-12525139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Difficult biliary cannulation during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) poses significant challenges and increases the risk of adverse events. Pancreatic guidewire (PGW)-assisted techniques offer potential solutions, but real-world comparative data are limited. Methods: This cohort study of prospectively collected data analyzed 234 ERCP cases from the Hungarian ERCP Registry, focusing on three PGW-assisted methods: transpancreatic sphincterotomy (TPS), double-guidewire technique (DGW), and prophylactic pancreatic stent-assisted cannulation (PPS-C).

pmc-12821972.title: Combined association of triglyceride-glucose index and the atherogenic index of plasma with the incidence of cardiovascular diseases among middle-aged and older population
pmc-12821972.creator: Xueyu Chen, Xuezhen Zhao, Haicheng Fei, Yixin Zhang, Jinhong Pang, Zhang Liu, Wenjuan Wang, Jianhong Qiao, Cuiping Xu
pmc-12821972.description: BackgroundCardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of death worldwide. The atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) reflects atherogenic dyslipidemia and triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index is a surrogate of insulin resistance (IR). Evidence on their combined value for CVDs risk stratification remain limited.

pmc-13319526.title: Development and validation of the Patient Involvement in Medication Communication at Hospital discharge Questionnaire (PIMCH-Q)
pmc-13319526.creator: Victoria Östman, Emma Bertilsson, Henrik Cam, Kristin Franzon, Sofia Kälvemark Sporrong, Emelie Frödén, Sham Shaat, Ulrika Gillespie
pmc-13319526.description: BackgroundMedication-related problems are common after hospital discharge, often due to inadequate communication about changes made to medication therapy. Patients’ ability to understand and manage medication changes after discharge is essential for safe and effective treatment. However, existing patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) do not adequately capture how patients perceive their involvement or understanding of peri- and post-discharge medication communication.

pmc-13341343.title: Enriched Metabolic Phenotyping Refines Phenotypic Resolution of Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13341343.creator: Min Wang, Yang Ou, Heng Su, Bing Zhang, Ben Niu, Anwar Ahmed, Guoqiang Xing
pmc-13341343.description: AimsData‐driven clustering studies of type 2 diabetes (T2D) based on limited routine clinical variables have reproducibly described major metabolic subgroups, including severe insulin‐deficient diabetes (SIDD), severe insulin‐resistant diabetes (SIRD), mild obesity‐related diabetes and mild age‐related diabetes. We examined whether deeper metabolic phenotyping can improve phenotypic resolution beyond these low‐dimensional frameworks.

pmc-13386593.title: Comparative efficacy of analgesic techniques in total hip arthroplasty
pmc-13386593.creator: Tim Cheok, Morgan Berman, William Jordan, Alexander Beveridge, Thomas Smith, Craig Morrison, Mehul Mayank, Ruurd L. Jaarsma, Job N. Doornberg
pmc-13386593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsWe compared the analgesic efficacy of commonly used analgesic techniques in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty (THA). uslaw-usc-t50-s2461.title: 50 U.S.C. § 2461 — Environmental protection, safety, and health requirements
uslaw-usc-t50-s2461.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s2461.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 41 (National Nuclear Security Administration); Subchapter V (Miscellaneous Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Compliance required The Administrator shall ensure that the Administration complies with all applicable environmental, safety, and health statutes and substantive requirements. (b) Procedures required The Administrator shall develop procedures for meeting such requirements. (c) Rule of construction.
